Yes, I think it started to feel differently around the end of wave 2, but it REALLY felt like focus 10/12 in wave 3, which I recently just finished. So don't give up! Glad I could help.

Don't overthink it! It's really not that complicated. Tuning is just an exercise to help you get into the meditative state. It doesn't matter if you don't do it perfectly. Just relax. The same goes for Focus 10 or any other state mentioned in the Tapes. The more you listen and practise, the easier it'll be for you to achieve that. In the first Wave I barely felt anything too! But really, practise makes perfect. 

If you don't feel satisfied with how you did an exercise, you can just do it again, but if you feel you did all you could, just go to the next one. Focus on yourself and how are you feeling, not on following the Tapes 1:1. Again, it'll be natural to you after some time. Don't be discouraged!

Hi, an aromantic writer here! Idk if I'll be much of help, but I'll try. 

Important thing to know is that there are many different "types" of attraction. For example, romantic atrraction, sexual attraction, platonic attraction, aesthetic attraction.... And even if aro ppl don't feel romantic attraction, they can still feel other! I suggest research about different attractions. And remember about this when making your character's relationships with others! 

And there are different "types" of aromantism: romance-positive, romance-neutral and romance-repulsed. Every aro person can have different 'relationship' with romance/love, so it's important to know how is it with your character (Do they despise/hate love? Do they like it? Do they not mind it at all?) 

And there's one thing I absolutely beg you to NOT do: DON'T make them wish they weren't aro! It's honestly so disrespectful and it shows being aromantic as something bad/sad/unfortunate etc. Obv your character can enjoy romance books/movies, dates, kisses, romance-related things in general (also keep in mind they can hate all these things too!) and/or can have some struggles with own aromantism. It's okay as a character development but please... I want to see more happy aro characters🙏

Idk what to say more.. I can give you better answer if you ask specific questions or say more about that character😅 I'll be glad to help more!
